title: Pure Dinowrestler
summary: Dinowrestler cards only, with generic Links and staples; the page's external Dinosaur engine is left out. Dinowrestlers are Dinosaurs that come out when the opponent controls more monsters. Dinowrestler Pankratops summons itself and tributes a Dinowrestler to destroy a card they control on either turn. Dinowrestler Systegosaur searches a Dinowrestler or World Dino Wrestling when Special Summoned. Dinowrestler Iguanodraka, the newest card, summons itself by discarding a Dinosaur and tributes a Dinosaur to revive a different Dinowrestler. Dinowrestler King T Wrextle forces their attacks onto it and stops Spells/Traps in battle. The Martial hand traps keep your Dinowrestlers alive in battle. World Dino Wrestling limits each player to one attacker and banishes itself from the GY to summon a Dinowrestler from the Deck. Tyrant Dino Fusion makes Dinowrestler Chimera T Wrextle on either turn.
